q1.title: Which kind of topic naturally pulls you in?
q1.a: Understanding how software, automation or data systems work
q1.b: Figuring out how machines, structures or physical systems work
q1.c: Exploring living systems, ecosystems and the natural world
q1.d: Examining people, culture, history and ideas

q2.title: When solving a problem, what kind of thinking feels most natural?
q2.a: Breaking things into clear steps, patterns or logic
q2.b: Testing ideas hands-on until something works
q2.c: Observing, researching and testing with evidence
q2.d: Interpreting meaning through language, ideas or philosophy

q3.title: Which kind of environment would energize you most?
q3.a: A fast-moving setting focused on strategy, leadership or innovation
q3.b: A learning environment where people grow through teaching or mentoring
q3.c: A care-focused setting centered on helping others
q3.d: A creative space for design, expression or artistic work

q4.title: Which kind of task could you happily spend hours on?
q4.a: Building or improving digital tools, systems or workflows
q4.b: Designing or improving physical objects or systems
q4.c: Creating visual, written or expressive creative work
q4.d: Studying people, groups or societies to find patterns

q5.title: Which kind of challenge feels motivating rather than draining?
q5.a: Turning ideas into products, plans or organizations
q5.b: Teaching, explaining or helping others understand
q5.c: Improving health, well-being or quality of life
q5.d: Creating something original through art, design or storytelling

q6.title: If you were leading a project, which role would you naturally take?
q6.a: Researching, testing ideas and working with data
q6.b: Communicating ideas through writing, speaking or storytelling
q6.d: Advocating for people, policy or social change

q7.title: If your work made a difference, what kind of impact would matter most to you?
q7.a: Helping people learn, grow or access education
q7.b: Improving health and wellness, or reducing suffering
q7.c: Deepening understanding of culture, ethics or ideas
q7.d: Making society fairer through systems, policy or community action

q8.title: Which sounds most like you right now?
q8.aText: I want to build the brain of the app: elegant code, secure data, systems that never break.
q8.bText: I want to investigate how the natural world works through observation and experiments.
q8.cText: I want to build organizations, make decisions and create value in the world.

q9.title: Which first project would you be most excited to start?
q9.a: Studying cells, molecules or how a disease spreads
q9.b: Designing a bridge, a machine or a better building
q9.c: Training a model or analyzing a large data set
q9.d: Researching how a community, market or government decision works

q10.title: Which of these would you most like to be known for?
q10.a: Helping people stay healthy and understand themselves
q10.b: Building and leading a successful venture
q10.c: Creating work that people see, read or hear
q10.d: Solving a hard problem with numbers and theory
